name: Harp
instruction: Let's create a 3D model of a harp. It should have a tall, triangular frame with a curved top. Strings should run vertically from the top to the base. Include tuning pegs at the top and pedals at the bottom for note changes.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a harp.
The frame of the harp is tall and triangular.
The top of the frame is curved.
The strings run vertically from the top to the base.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The height of the frame should be significantly greater than its width.
The spacing of the strings should be uniform and proportional to the frame.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The triangular frame is positioned upright for stability.
The strings are evenly spaced and taut from the top to the base.
The tuning pegs are located at the top of the frame, accessible for tuning.
The pedals are positioned at the bottom of the frame, allowing for foot access.
Object distance and contact: The strings do not overlap with the frame.
There is no gap between the strings and the frame.
The tuning pegs are securely attached to the frame.
The pedals are firmly connected to the base of the harp.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The triangular frame and curved top are correctly modeled.
The vertical strings are included as instructed.
Tuning pegs and pedals are appropriately placed.
